title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper Droitwich

Salary: 28,000 to 40,000 (dependent on experience)

Location: Droitwich

Bell Cornwall Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting for a Bookkeeper to join a growing organisation based in Droitwich. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a small, friendly team and develop your finance skills within a varied and fast-paced environment.

The opportunity

Are you a numerate, organised individual with an eye for detail and an interest in finance? - Use spreadsheets for financial analysis and reporting.

- Previous experience in bookkeeping or a similar finance or accounting role.
- An understanding of accounting software, ideally Xero or a similar system.
- Strong numerical skills and confidence using spreadsheets.
- An understanding of debits and credits, double-entry bookkeeping and account reconciliations.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities effectively.
- Strong analytical and communication skills.
- A proactive attitude, with a willingness to learn and develop within a supportive team.

title: Contact Centre Supervisor
description:
Our client is a well established, market leading manufacturer that supplies to wholesalers and direct consumers.

Their contact centre helps customers choose the right products, place their order and get support right through to delivery and beyond. We're looking for a Supervisor who loves a busy floor, gets the best out of people and is as passionate about sales as they are about service.

The role

Reporting to our Contact Centre Manager, you'll lead a team of advisors across phone, live chat, text and email. You'll make sure customers get a quick, helpful answer every time, help the team turn conversations into sales, and keep the day running smoothly.

You'll be working with our Holly AI Advisor, our AI chat assistant, which handles routine questions so advisors can focus on higher-value conversations. You'll help shape how AI and people work together to give customers a better experience.

What you'll do
- Lead, motivate and support a team of advisors day to day, on the floor and hands-on
- Manage queues in real time to hit answer rates and chat response times, moving people where they're needed
- Coach advisors to grow sales, including on higher-value products
- Monitor calls and chats, give clear feedback and run regular one-to-ones
- Handle escalated calls and complaints, putting things right for customers fairly and quickly
- Manage attendance, holidays and absence, and help plan cover for seasonal peaks
- Use 8x 8 wallboards and reporting to track performance and spot issues early
- Train new starters and keep product and process knowledge up to date
- Help improve our AI chat advisor by spotting gaps and feeding back on what customers ask
- Work with delivery, after sales and quality teams to resolve problems and stop them happening again

What you'll bring
- Experience as a supervisor or team leader in a contact centre, or a strong advisor ready to step up
- A track record in sales, ideally with targets or commission
- A calm, confident approach to complaints and difficult conversations
- A fair, firm and supportive style of managing people
- Good knowledge of contact centre KPIs and real-time queue management
- Confidence with Excel and reporting
- Comfort with technology, and an interest in how AI can help customers and advisors

It would be great if you also have
- Experience of 8x 8 or a similar cloud contact centre platform
- Experience working alongside a chatbot or virtual agent
- A background in e-commerce, home and garden or high-value consumer products
- Working knowledge of UK consumer rights

title: Accounts Assistant

description:
The opportunity

We are looking for an Accounts Assistant with strong communication skills to join a transactional Finance team in Droitwich for a well established family business.
This is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their finance career who wants more than a traditional desk based transactional role.
Alongside day-to-day finance responsibilities, 1-2 times a month, you will visit stake holders off site, and work directly with site teams to improve financial processes, resolve discrepancies and provide practical training around till management, banking and online payment gateways.
With just over 90 sites in England and Wales, you could be working with a wide range of people and environments. You will often be meeting people for the first time who have little or no finance background and who may be resistant to changing established ways of working. Because of this, your ability to communicate clearly, adapt your approach and build relationships quickly will be just as important as your finance experience.
You will be the face of the finance team when visiting sites, so confidence, credibility and a genuinely helpful approach are essential.
What you'll be doing
Site visits, training and relationship building
- Visit client sites approximately 1 to 2 times per month to support managers and operational teams
- Deliver practical training on till management, banking procedures, till float reconciliations and online payment gateways
- Explain financial processes and controls in straightforward, practical language to people without a finance background
- Build rapport quickly with site managers and stakeholders, creating positive relationships between operational teams and Finance
- Handle resistance to new processes positively and confidently, helping people understand why changes are needed
- Investigate cash variances and till discrepancies on site, working collaboratively with managers to understand the cause and find a solution
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and strengthen financial controls across sites
Banking and cash reconciliation
- Complete daily and weekly reconciliations across multiple sites
- Reconcile merchant receipts, till cash and online payment gateway transactions against bank accounts
- Investigate discrepancies and ensure issues are resolved accurately and promptly
Credit control and income collection
- Manage B2 B accounts, party bookings and corporate invoices
- Support timely collection of outstanding monies
- Respond to queries and work with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues
Wider finance support
- Work as part of the wider Transactional Finance team
- Provide support and cover across different areas of Transactional Finance when required
- Build your knowledge of the wider finance function and develop your accounting experience

What we're looking for
The person behind the numbers is particularly important for this role.
You will need to be:
- Confident communicating with new people and able to establish credibility quickly
- Comfortable delivering training to individuals and small groups
- Able to explain financial processes simply and clearly to people who do not work in finance
- Comfortable dealing with people who may initially be resistant to change
- Personable, approachable and confident representing the Finance team on site
- Naturally good at building relationships with stakeholders at different levels
- Accurate and organised, with good attention to detail
- Curious and willing to investigate discrepancies rather than simply identifying them
- Comfortable working independently when visiting sites
- Willing and able to travel to client locations around 1 to 2 times per month with own transport (travel expenses will be paid).
Previous transactional finance, accounts payable, reconciliation, cash handling or credit control experience would be useful, but attitude, communication skills and the desire to develop a career in finance will be particularly important.

Why join?
This isn't a role where you'll spend your whole career processing transactions.
It offers a strong starting point for someone who wants to build a broader career in finance. You will gain exposure to transactional finance, reconciliations, financial controls, operational stakeholders and multi-site environments while developing valuable commercial and communication skills.
As your knowledge and experience grow, the role could provide a foundation for progression into areas such as Financial Accounting, Management Accounting or a wider accounting career.
With hybrid working, flexible start and finish times and regular opportunities to get out of the office and work directly with sites, it would particularly suit someone who enjoys variety, meeting people and taking ownership.
Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.

description: The Podiatry Service at The John Anthony Centre is seeking a skilled, well-motivated Administrative Assistant to join our friendly and dedicated administrative team. This is a 30 hour post, though part-time hours will be considered for the right candidate, with a minimum of 25 hours. You will work closely with--and be fully supported by--our experienced administrator within a well-established service based at Kidderminster Health Centre. We are looking for an individual who is self-driven, reliable, and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive approach are essential. You will receive full Trust and Service Induction, along with ongoing guidance and supervision from our existing team to help you settle into the role and develop confidently. We are committed to supporting flexible working and are happy to discuss working patterns that meet individual needs while ensuring the smooth running of the service Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. A role in our team offers a welcoming, supportive environment where your contribution truly matters. Each day brings variety and purpose: you'll handle and organise incoming and outgoing mail, respond to emails promptly, speak with patients, carers and colleagues over the phone, process referrals, book appointments for the clinical team, arrange home visits, maintain supplies, and carry out a range of general administrative tasks that keep the service running smoothly. You'll be based in a friendly office setting, working closely with our podiatrists to ensure their clinical day flows effortlessly. From coordinating referrals and appointments to providing practical support throughout the day, you'll play a key part in helping them deliver excellent patient care. Although you'll work independently, you'll always have guidance from the senior administrator and strong connections with the wider admin team across community podiatry. It's a place where people look out for one another, share knowledge, and collaborate to make the service the best it can be. Undertake administrative duties specific to the role eg typing standard keyboard skills required, data inputting, filing, scanning, referral processing, adding appointments to clinicians diaries and home visits. Add new patient spells and referral on the system in a timely manner. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries in a professional manner seeking guidance as required, recording details accurately and forwarding to the relevant member of the team in a timely manner Process incoming and outgoing mail Order and maintain stock supplies Prepare for and attend appraisal meetings and participate in any relevant training programmes required by the Trust For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.

title: Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator
description: The Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator plays a vital role in ensuring the accuracy, completeness and integrity of workforce records across Vertis Health. Acting as a central point for workforce data assurance, the postholder will maintain reliable information within Sage HR, oversee compliance trackers, reconcile staff records and audit electronic personnel files. By identifying and resolving data discrepancies, coordinating corrective actions and providing clear assurance reporting, the role helps create a trustworthy workforce picture that supports effective decision-making, regulatory compliance and high-quality patient care. This is a detail-focused position that combines data accuracy, process improvement and stakeholder collaboration to reduce administrative burden and enable managers and staff to focus on delivering excellent services. This is a part-time role for 16 hours per week. The main duties of the Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator are to maintain accurate and reliable workforce records across Vertis Health by monitoring workforce data in Sage HR, reviewing compliance trackers, reconciling staff lists and auditing electronic personnel files. The postholder will identify and correct data discrepancies, update records where evidence is available, coordinate actions with the appropriate teams when further checks or decisions are required, and track outstanding issues through to resolution. They will also produce regular assurance reports, monitor compliance trends, and support the continuous improvement of workforce record-keeping processes, helping to ensure that managers have access to accurate information and that services remain compliant, efficient and focused on delivering high-quality patient care. The Workforce Compliance and Assurance Administrator plays a key role in supporting the effective management of workforce information across Vertis Health. The position exists to ensure that workforce records, compliance data, staff information and personnel files are accurate, complete and trustworthy. By creating confidence in workforce data, the postholder helps managers, HR colleagues and operational teams access reliable information quickly, reducing administrative burden and allowing services to focus on the delivery of high-quality patient care.
